ambient: A section adjusts, load moving across it, and settles.
The pattern completes a very large figure and starts the next.
Somewhere along it, something is being repaired.
description: The structure with nothing living in it. Just the thing itself, going away in every direction, holding. It was made and it's being maintained and there's nobody in this part of it. It's the most beautiful thing you have been shown and it wasn't shown to you.
name: The Lattice

looks: It holds. It's holding everywhere at once, without effort.
The joints are the interesting part. Somebody solved them.
It goes on past where you can follow it and it doesn't thin out.
objects.name: the lattice

looks: More of it. The same standard, all the way out.
Something is working out there, small with distance, and unhurried.
The light changes across it, slowly, in the shape of a very long day.
objects.name: the far reaches

weather: Cool, and moving, and clean as the inside of an instrument.
